question: Can the T1 success predicate (one worker, >=30% less than the H1 suite, no coverage lost) be met?

likeForLike.method: Same file|title|project cases in the 2026-10-19 back-to-back pair (test-timing.json raw reports)

appOpenProbe.method: Fresh context, goto / until Crea il corso (cold) and reload with a course (reload); 5 samples per engine; Pixel 7 Chromium, iPhone 13 WebKit
appOpenProbe.units: ms, medians rounded; WebKit runs varied by up to 1 s between batches

phaseProbe.method: Temporary performance marks in prepareDatabase on the dev server, reverted; not committed

webkit.afterInitPreparationMs: ~450 (session bind, version read, claim, two repair checks)

levers.lever: Serve a production build instead of the Vite dev server
levers.estimate: about 0.5-0.8 s per page load, ~6 min
levers.cost: 22 specs import /src modules for seeding; needs a test seeding entry in the build

levers.lever: Restore WebKit app-open time to H1 (product performance)
levers.estimate: ~1 s per WebKit open; real iPhone benefit
levers.cost: investigate engine init and batch the post-init preparation reads

levers.estimate: wall time roughly divides by workers (2 -> ~30 min, 3 -> ~22 min)
levers.cost: contradicts the one-worker predicate; needs per-worker server/port isolation checks and flake watch

conclusion: No combination of single-worker levers found reaches 23.8 min without removing cases or projects. The owner must choose a revised target or accept the miss.
